svg.title: Lidar placement boxes
svg.desc: Top view of the inspection conveyor, drawn to scale, x to the right from 0.45 to 1.55 m and y up from 0.65 to 1.35 m. The gray belt runs from x 0.5 to 1.5 m between y 0.95 and 1.05 m. Tag 1: box A, a green box from x 0.5 to 1.1 m and y 0.7 to 0.95 m, below the belt. Tag 2: box B, the same size above the belt, y 1.05 to 1.3 m. Tag 3: box C, a dashed green outline over the belt itself from x 0.5 to 1.1 m. Tag 4: a small circle, the cell at its spawn point, x 0.55 m. Tags 5 and 6: dashed lines across the belt at x 1.0 m and x 1.25 m. Tag 7: an arrow pointing along +x. Tag 8: two green triangles at x 0.65 m, one in box A at y 0.9 m and one in box B at y 1.1 m, each pointing at the belt.
